languages._note: BCP 47 tags. artifacts: work artifacts only (PRD, techspec, tasks, specs); code: code, file names, docs, commits and branches. Set with: devflow-config set languages.<key> <tag>

adapters._note: tracker: manual | none | github-issues; deploy: fly | none

qa._note: QA stage (qa-engineer skill, gate qa) between local validation and review. true: the qa gate is required; false: it is dropped. Toggle with: devflow-config set qa.enabled on|off

secret._note: pnpm-lock.yaml lists the npm package "js-tokens", which the secret pattern flags as an assignment

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.usage: AI answers (api); optional, search works without it

commands.gates: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm format:check
commands.e2e: pnpm e2e (Playwright, stub API fixtures) for the touched flow
commands.rollout: local only in release 1: API before web; promotion develop -> main is the owner's release decision
